ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
<image>In $\odot G, m \angle A G B=30$ and $\overline{C G} \perp \overline{G D}$.
Find $m \widehat{A B}$
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circle with G as the center; A, B, C, D, F are on the circumference, and radii are drawn from the center G to these points; GA and GB form the central angle ∠AGB. The figure also marks a right-angle mark showing CG perpendicular to GD. Reasoning: The problem gives m∠AGB = 30°. Because AB is the arc intercepted by the central angle ∠AGB, the measure of arc AB is equal to the measure of the corresponding central angle, so m\widehat{AB} = 30°. CG ⟂ GD is unrelated to finding arc AB.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at G, with A and B located on the circumference and segments GA and GB forming the central angle ∠AGB. From the text, take m∠AGB = 30°. Since an arc's measure equals the measure of its central angle, the minor arc AB has measure 30°.
